title: Binary representation of a quotient
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, extract its two paired bit lists and interpret them as natural numbers $a$ and $b$. The definition assigns to $z$ the binary digit list of the natural-number quotient $a/b$, using the natural-number convention when $b=0$.
caveat: The supplied context does not define how the list is split into paired components or how a bit list is interpreted as a natural number.
